name: regions-research
gates: node -e "const t=require('fs').readFileSync('docs/research/regions.md','utf8'); const n=['Kansai','Jalisco','Valley of Mexico','Antioquia','Hudson','Sweden','Andalusia','Paulo'].filter(r=>!t.includes(r)); if(n.length){console.log('missing regions: '+n.join(', '));process.exit(1)} if(!/#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}/.test(t)){console.log('no hex colors');process.exit(1)}"
